content:
今天是 Tim Cook 擔任 Apple 行政總裁（CEO）的最後一天，John Ternus 將於明天接棒。為紀念他最後一天任職，Cook 今天向 Apple 員工發出一封感人的備忘錄。請細閱以下內容。

在今早發給員工、由 9to5Mac 取得的備忘錄中，Cook 回顧了他在 Apple 的歲月，並感謝員工們一直以來的努力。他亦表示，將帥印交給「如 John Ternus 般才華出眾、為人出眾、能力卓越的人」令其深感安慰。

Cook 寫道：「很少人像 John 那樣了解打造改變世界產品所需的一切，我對他的領導感到無比興奮。」

以下是備忘錄全文：

Team — Today is my last day as Apple’s CEO. I’ve always known this day would come, but even as it arrives and I write these words, I still find it hard to believe. I love this company and its people more than I can put into words, and I couldn’t let the day go by without saying a few words to you — to tell you how grateful I am for the kindness you have shown me, for your dedication every single day, and most of all, for the privilege of being your leader — the honor of a lifetime. The truth is, whatever the outside world says about my success, I know it is because of you. You bring out the best in me. I have never in my life met or worked with a group of people as talented as you, and I see more examples of that every single day. There is something truly special about Apple. What I am most proud of is what no annual report can capture. This place has proven that culture can defeat everything. We share a common belief: that what we make matters, and that we have both the opportunity and the responsibility to leave the world better than we found it. That sense of purpose is part of what makes this place unlike anywhere else. Apple helped nurture it, but I believe it was already in each of you long before you ever walked through these doors. It is what brought you here, and what keeps you going each day. Together we’ve created something far beyond what any one of us could have imagined or achieved alone. That is our secret. We bring out the best in each other. We lift each other up. It’s because of who we are, what we believe, what we value, and how we see the world that we have been able, as Steve used to say, to put a dent in the universe. How lucky we are. How lucky I am. As you know, I’m not going Apple, but I am saying goodbye to a role I love. I will miss this job in ways I cannot yet articulate, even as I feel at peace with this decision. I will miss leading you, walking alongside you every step of the way. And I will miss looking up from my desk and seeing your faces, even as I take comfort in knowing that the torch will be passed to someone as talented, as principled, as capable as John. Few people know what it takes to build the kind of products that change the world like John does, and I could not be more excited about his leadership. I want you to know how grateful I am, and how proud I am, to have been your CEO. Most of all, I want you to keep being proud of what you do and where you do it, and always give everything you’ve got. When we pour ourselves into this work, when we care about each other, when we care about the people we serve — there is nothing we cannot do. I look forward to seeing you in my new role, at Apple Park and around the world, and I’ll carry with me the pride I feel in all of you, always. — Tim
